meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image, Riverflow). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文字描述生成图像,或基于参考图编辑合成新图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把文字想象变成图片素材,或对已有图片做编辑合成
copy.tagline_en: Generate images from text prompts, or edit and composite photos using reference images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn text descriptions into images or edit photos without design software.

howto.what: 根据你的文字描述生成图片,或对已有图片进行编辑修改(如换背景、加元素),并将结果保存为 PNG 文件。适用于照片、插画、概念图等非技术图表类画面。
howto.when: 当你要求生成照片、插画、艺术图、概念图等非技术图表类图像,或对已有图片进行编辑时触发;使用前需已配置 OpenRouter API 密钥。

say.text: 帮我画一张日落时分的山景照片
say.note: 会用默认模型生成并保存为 PNG 文件

say.text: 把这张照片的背景改成蓝色
say.note: 需提供图片路径,进入编辑模式

say.text: 用 flux.2-pro 画一只太空中的猫
say.note: 指定使用 FLUX.2 Pro 模型生成

howto.what_en: Generates or edits images via OpenRouter models from a text prompt, saving the result as a PNG file. Works for photos, illustrations, concept art, and general visuals; technical diagrams are handled by another skill.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to create or edit images that are not technical diagrams (e.g., photos, illustrations, artwork, logos). Requires an OpenRouter API key to be configured.

say_en.text: Draw a photo of a mountain at sunset.
say_en.note: Uses the default model and saves as PNG.

say_en.text: Change the background of this photo to blue.
say_en.note: Provide the image path to enter edit mode.

say_en.text: Draw a cat in space using flux.2-pro.
